name: border-legends
description: 边境传说 - 3D 冒险动作游戏 (Border Legends)

scripts.electron: npm run electron:build && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.electron:watch: concurrently `"vite build -c vite.electron.config.ts -w"` `"tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json -w"` `"cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron . --watch"`
scripts.build-win: npm run build && vite build -c vite.electron.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.build-mac: npm run build && vite build -c vite.electron.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.build-linux: npm run build && vite build -c vite.electron.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron-builder --linux --x64
